Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is Seiren Private Academy’s “solitary princess.” She’s a half-Russian beauty with silver hair, at the top of her class, student council accountant, and…completely unapproachable. For some reason, she’s also taken on the responsibility of reprimanding the slacker who sits next to her in class. Masachika Kuze is constantly frustrating her by falling asleep, forgetting his textbooks, and just being an overall unexemplary student. Or at least, that’s how it looks from the outside. She may put on a tough act, but she doesn’t mind Masachika as much as others would think. She even lets him call her by her nickname, Alya. Anyone hearing the comments she mutters in Russian under her breath might know how she really feels, but since none of her classmates understand the language, she’s free to say whatever she likes! Except…there is one person who knows what she’s saying. Masachika eavesdrops on her embarrassing revelations, pretending to be clueless, all the while wondering what her flirtatious comments actually mean!

130694.description:
After Ming Shu finished his training and returned to Dongye City’s Criminal Investigation Bureau, he found that Xiao Yu'an, his old neighbor who was like a big brother to him that left without saying goodbye many years ago, had suddenly become his immediate superior. What was crazier was that they also became housemates and started living together!

While Ming Shu juggled that headache of a situation, mysterious murder cases followed one after another - an unemployed man suddenly going crazy in a book cafe, the most hardworking performer of a Chinese orchestra dying strangely, an escape room game that seemed to be more than a game... Ming Shu, ‘This time, I won’t let you go.’

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

130695.description:
The duchy of Alita was invaded by the monarchy, the Empire of Sckinia, and is now under its rule. The children of the nobility of the former duchy were incorporated into the imperial educational system, where they are given the duty of becoming mates with a partner chosen by the empire in spring when they turn 18, and have children. Tiana, a daughter of a count, is chosen to become mates with an elite knight, Adel, with whom she's always butted heads with since they were children. Arguing and bickering with each other, their completely unromantic first night begins. Tiana thought this would be their first and last night together, but Adel calls on her night after night, saying it's their duty... A romantic fantasy story of mates who can't seem to be honest with each other!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

伯爵千金被强迫与水火不容的精英骑士成为伴侣

130697.description:
Uno, a former bartender and flirt, comes to the cake shop where the serious new patissier, Fujisaki, works. At first, Fujisaki dislikes the frivolous Uno, but he gradually begins to be attracted to Uno's friendliness and surprisingly talented work...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

130698.description:
Miyu is a restaurant's daughter in the countryside, always helping out the family business. One day a couple of city boys visit and she meets a blondie named Keito for the first time?! Watch what unfolds in this sweet love story! ♡

Luna Xia summoned a devil to help retaliate against her classmates. However, she never expected to summon the Devil King! Suddenly, Luna's life starts to take off on a crazy roller coaster of events! The once popular superstar goddess, now scorned by the public as a big fat shut-in. See how the powerful heroine transforms from a weak loser to a strong queen, seduces the prince charming, and returns to the peak as the film queen.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

130708.description:
An Alpha named Tae-Yoon reminisces the night he had together with Omega Eun-Hoo before he disappeared. As if by fate, the two meet once again; and Eun-Hoo has a child, making Tae-Yoon believe he's taken. Tae-Yoon decides to just be friends with Eun-Hoo and his son, but will he let go of his love for him?

130709.description: Set in the 1590s, this manga tells the story of the rise of kabuki theater. Kiki is traveling with her mother, Izumo no Okuni, as she tries to spread the popularity of her new style of dramatic dancing. They face a lot of difficulties in this politically tumultuous period of history, as the warring states period comes to a close and Japan moves towards unification.

Any love story aficionado will say that the key to a successful couple is intense desire for one another-but what if the characters in question are an asexual woman with a passion for Boys Love stories and a gay man whose heart forever belongs to his oblivious childhood friend? Although romance will never be in the cards for newlyweds Yuriko and Gakurouta, the bond blossoming between them promises to be a wonderful relationship-the likes of which neither has ever experienced before…

(Source: Yen Press)

Fashion stylist, Ji Xun, traverses across ancient times. He should have married a beauty from a decent family and realized the pinnacle of his life, unexpectedly, he is narrowly stared by a man! Is it actually this life's debt or prior life's untied fetters?

(Source: Webnovel)

130716.description:
Celestia was in love and dreaming of a brighter tomorrow until, out of the blue, her fiancé cheated on her and left her for dead. Suddenly, she was alone with nothing. Enter the Emperor, cold and aloof with unlimited power and wealth. He was alone with everything. But now these two have each other. Her cunning and courage make her invaluable to him, and yet it’s the secret they share that makes them inseparable... and a target for those who crave power. Will their relationship remain professional, or will it become something magical?

(Source: Tapas)

Kohaku Hatano, a boy who has regained the memory of his previous life in a world where the male-female ratio is greatly different and men are given preferential treatment. He decides to become a “Devilish Man” in order to get a better life.

Kohaku was thinking about various plans to add value to himself, such as training his body and studying for the future, but just by greeting and talking with a smile, the woman around him captivated to him.

130733.description:
In an alternate 2023, the Your Forma, a miraculous “smart thread” technology initially developed to treat a massive outbreak of viral encephalitis, has become an integral part of daily life. But these convenient devices come with an invasive drawback—they record every sight, sound, and even emotion their users experience. For electronic investigator Echika Hieda, diving into peoples’ memories via the Your Forma and hunting for evidence to solve the toughest crimes is all part of a day’s work. The problem is, she’s so good at what she does that her assistants literally fry their brains trying to keep up with her. After putting one too many aides in the hospital, the top brass finally furnish Echika with a partner on her level, a brilliant yet cheeky android named Harold Lucraft. Does this unlikely duo have what it takes to resolve their mutual suspicions and avert a deadly technological infection from sweeping across the globe before it’s too late?

(Source: Yen Press)

For some reason, his schoolmates keep mistaking him for the shadowy figure picking off unruly students one by one—and trying to pay him back for the beatings. Not the type to sit and wait, Kalego and his classmate Balam start searching for the real culprit, only to find themselves in a cat-and-mouse game of demonic proportions…!

D-rank beast-tamer Lint takes all the worst jobs just trying to scrape by and survive–but all that changes for the better when a hot S-rank catgirl named Birena begs him to tame her! There’s no lock Detective Do-Bin Kim can’t open. With his unique ‘opening’ ability, he can unlock anything -- even people -- to get the information he needs to hunt down criminals and solve crimes. Enter Locker -- his polar opposite and his enemy. When Locker uses her ability to ‘lock’ a witness and prevents Kim from accessing key information in a crucial case, they plunge into a cat-and-mouse game with justice itself at stake. When two equal forces collide, who will emerge the victor?

When Ji-U Seo moves out of her childhood friend’s mansion and into a small one-bedroom apartment, she thinks her world is ending — that is, until she meets Ha-Jun and Ha-Yul, the neglected children who live downstairs. When a scouting offer comes in for Ha-Jun to join an idol survival program, Ji-U encourages him to audition, completely unaware of how it will change the trajectory of her and everyone else’s lives forever.

Yi Feng is a diligent girl in her studies on science and engineering, and a person who believes in the power of ones own strength. Until one day, she could suddenly see that everyone had a score on their heads, and this score seemed to be related to the value of ones beauty. Finally, Yi Feng, who was able to distinguish between beauty and ugliness, found out that all kinds of troubles come with being ugly. Then, a male beauty appeared in front of her. Will he be the start of Yi Feng’s new hope? But this path to becoming a CEO goddess and marrying Gao Shuaifu does not seem to be an easy one…

130747.description:
The Emperor of Thunder, Chen Lei, failed in his ascension, and as fate would have it, he reincarnated back to his teenage days when his family hadn't been destroyed and his parents hadn’t died tragically. Chen Lei is determined to make up for his regrets! With memories of his past life, Chen Lei, with his enormous talents, embarks on his ultimate journey to become invincible—to protect his family, to crush his enemies, and attain all the treasures in the world. When he’s drunk, he’s surrounded by pretty women; when he’s sober, he’s the invincible supreme with the power to control the world!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

130748.description:
In the busy streets of Shinjuku, Keigo lives a careless life as a gangster. Before meeting Haiji and his gang, he was alone and unwanted. Now, Keigo is Haiji's most treasured pet, and Haiji will end anyone who gets to lay a finger on him. In a world of violence, will these two be able to last?

The OL Tae Honda went swimming at the community pool, but her lack of exercise caused her to cramp up in the water, when she was saved by a tall, beautiful girl Mai Igarashi. Feeling attracted to her savior as she left the the pool, Tae saw Mai come out carrying an elementary school backpack…

Uruno started as an intern in a programming company where the person he's interested in, his senior, Hongo, works at. While Uruno is skeptical about love matters, he finds himself drawn to Hongo every time he spends with him. All in all, Uruno was fine with the way things are. But when Hongo transfers out, Uruno is left hollow and indifferent. When news of Hongo's company being booted outreaches Uruno, he is persistent in finding Hongo. He succeeds in finding Hongo, now jobless and homeless, with only his drones for company. Desperate to keep Hongo by his side, Uruno offers to buy Hongo for $50,000.

130763.description:
Successful businessman Kou Tsubaki is hopelessly in love with the jobless Kentaro Shimono. While attending a singles party, Kou bumps into Kentaro, who was a few grades above him in high school. The only reason Kou was there in the first place was to get over Kentaro... When Kou learns that Kentaro is homeless, he invites the older man to stay with him, and Kentaro doesn't mind showing Kou just how grateful he is. How will Kou react when the man of his dreams is right in front of him...!?

Prior to the 2020 Education Reform, "our man" is coming back! He's the legendary attorney Sakuragi Kenji, who will waltz back to the fallen Ryuzan High School where the students' academic aptitude is plummeting. In opposition to apathetic students and "The Empress" (Representative of the Chief Director) who wields overwhelming authority, he will start a revolution along with Mizuno, his former pupil. Part 2 of Dragon Zakura, the legendary "manga that will help you pass the University of Tokyo entrance exams"—which helped change the landscape of Japan's university entrance exams—is here at last! Rest assured, entering the University of Tokyo is going to be a cinch.

130769.description: The Demon King, who terrorized the world for twenty-five years, was slain. However, the Hero who killed him never came forward. Therefore, in order to decide on the "True Hero" that will be acknowledged by everyone as the strongest, sixteen "Asuras", masters of extraordinary abilities, are gathered in the great kingdom of the Yellow Capital! "Insta-Kill Blade", "Almighty Magic", "Absolute Defense"... The ultimate deathmatch for the title of the strongest in another world begins now!

130770.description:
When they were younger, cool, collected Kousuke was the one who asked tiny, adorable Hiraku to be his lover - even when Hiraku couldn't quite understand what being lovers meant. Now that they're older and hopefully wiser, can they finally figure out what they got wrong the first time?

130771.description: Years after the events of Ultimate Path Private High School 2011, Edajima Heihachi is informed of an invading alien race called the Susanoo, who seek to harvest the testicles of Japanese men to harness the Spirit of Yamato as an energy source. A heroic princess vs an adorable prince, a scheming version of the prince is on the way... Can she reverse her fate after dying for three times?

As a girl from the modern world, I transmigrated to the ancient times and acquired a superpower. But it's okay, I was given a second chance to be reborn. I fulminated against the royal family, punished the wicked, and conquered the harem! But I met the man who killed me in my last life. Sietsye, a princess hailing from a small country, traveled a long way to the powerful northern Kingdom of Verscia so as to wed its ruler, the haughty and overbearing Emperor Gaizel.

The lonely Gaizel was a man known as the Ice Emperor, and is as frightening as he is revered. But, when faced with him, his inner thoughts - a sharp contrast to his icy demeanor - drift over to Sietsye, going far beyond her wildest imaginations—?!

She has hidden her identity and dedicates her body and soul to the emperor as a princess…

"Don't hide. Move your hands away, Princess Alesha." Alesha exposes her naked body to the cold-hearted emperor… At the behest of the queen of her home country, Cadrela, Alesha is forced to marry Valhram, emperor of R?Cksen, in the crown princess's place to make him sign a peace treaty. She believes that it is all to bring peace to both countries, but… "Overstimulation breaks the mind, not the body." The emperor corrupts Alesha's innocent body even as he rejects her, saying, "I don't need a sacrificial bride." However, as she spends time with him, Alesha becomes attracted to the kindness that hides behind his coldness…

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Marshall Emperor and His Sacrificial Bride
title.native: 元帥皇帝に捧げられた花嫁

130799.description:
Hajime, a girl who can’t seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There’s always been things she’s wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she’s given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do.
That’s when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her schoolー

(Source: Dogenzaka Shobo, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ファインダー越しのあの子

130800.description:
It is common knowledge that it is best to become an adventurer while you are young. This is because the "magical power" that is the basis of an adventurer's strength can only be developed if the adventurer trains while young. But this newbie adventurer, Rick Gladiator, who only became an adventurer at the age of 30, had the fighting strength of an S-rank adventurer, the highest rank. People thought that the "Mere Old Man" would not make a good adventurer! But in fact, Rick has lived an unimaginable daily life with the members of the legendary "Orichalcone Fist," a party of the continent's most powerful adventurers. From dragons to vampires, Rick has been trained by literally "monster" level masters, and with his fighting skills, he is able to defeat the elite adventurers who underestimate him.

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)
synonyms: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

title.native: 新米オッサン冒険者、最強パーティに死ぬほど鍛えられて無敵になる。
title.romaji: Shinmai Ossan Bouken-sha, Saikyou Party ni Shinu Hodo Kitaerarete Muteki ni Naru.

130801.description:
Shu, who died of old age, reincarnated as a baby in a different world where he was picked up by a poor orphanage. He quickly grows up under the watchful eye of the gentle director and staff. With skills received from God, he starts to exert talent… He now lives at his own pace, adventuring with cute monsters and good friends ♪

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

130802.description:
Constantin de Arambourg, the knight of the garden, is an overly serious knight who guards the king's kitchen garden. One day, he met a beautiful woman chasing a rabbit in the garden. When she caught the rabbit with her bare hands, she said: "I'll turn you into a meat pie, rabbit!" When she said this with a smile, his heart was struck like lighting - and he fell in love!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 『王の菜園』の騎士と、『野菜』のお嬢様
title.romaji: "Ou no Saien" no Kishi to, "Yasai" no Ojou-sama

title.native: 恋人代行をはじめた俺、なぜか美少女の指名依頼が入ってくる
title.romaji: Koibito Daikou wo Hajimeta Ore, Naze ka Bishoujo no Shimei Irai ga Haitte kuru

130804.description:
Seven years ago, before my best friend and I were torn apart by a big move, we promised we would be friends forever, no matter how much distance was put between us. But when I finally found him again at my new high school, I didn’t expect him to be…the most beautiful girl I’ve ever seen in my life. Wait, so does this mean he—or, I guess, she—was a girl this whole time?! It’s honestly insane. With everyone else, she’s a pristine flower, literally Miss Perfect. But when it’s just us, she’s the same goblin I’ve always known. I guess some things truly never change. And yet…

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: เพื่อนสมัยเด็กที่เคยคิดว่าเป็นผู้ชายดันกลายเป็นสาวสวยในโรงเรียนใหม่
轉學後班上的清純可愛美少女，竟是小時候玩在一起的哥兒們
Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her

title.english: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her
title.native: 転校先の清楚可憐な美少女が、昔男子と思って一緒に遊んだ幼馴染だった件
title.romaji: Tenkousaki no Seiso Karen na Bishoujo ga, Mukashi Danshi to Omotte Issho ni Asonda Osananajimi datta Ken

130805.description:
Kotoko Tsukishiro is a cool, strong-willed high school girl with no experience in romance. Kiyo Kazuki is a teahouse owner with a graceful and elegant demeanor. A story about the first love spun between two people.

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

title.native: 香月さんの恋する時間

130806.description:
Who knew the Midnight Association for the Broken Hearted had so many members? Let's start with some introductions: First, we have two members who are delighted to have found each other and bond over their similarities. But, when the time comes, can they?... Our next two association members are head over heels for each other but have a peculiar way of showing it. Then, we have a blackmailing member taking advantage of the infamous school delinquent. (Warning: dubious consent) Next are some action heroes getting some action of their own. And lastly, we have two lovebirds who go on a date in the wild, only to get stuck in a hut alone... with each other...

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: The Midnight Association For The Broken Hearted

130807.description:
Certo is a boy born in a village on the border between the demon realm and the human realm. Because of his upbringing in this special environment, he gained the extraordinary ability to fire ultra-long-range magic that defeated the academy's hero candidates before they could even move! An unparalleled school fantasy beyond the range of all common sense!

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Mugen Shatei Majutsu Tsukai no Ore wa, Yagate Gakuen no Chouten he
むげん射程魔術使いの俺は、やがて学園の頂点へ
無限射程魔術使いの俺は、やがて学園の頂点へ

title.native: ∞射程魔術使いの俺は、やがて学園の頂点へ
title.romaji: ∞Shatei Majutsu Tsukai no Ore wa, Yagate Gakuen no Chouten he

130808.description:
"Expulsion boom." In this world, such phrase had become prevalent. With the advent of "Status Scouter," a convenient item that quantifies and visualizes stats, a trend was set for high-ranking parties to expel their friends whose status numbers were on the low-end. Eisen, who had graduated from the Guild Master Academy, had been harboring doubts regarding the status-oriented world. In addition, with his inherent skill called "Appraisal Eye" that detects hidden skills in people, he realized that the adventurers who had been exiled for their "incompetence" were actually competent people with hidden skills. Thus, Eisen decided to initiate a new guild for these exiles and took them in one after another. Just like that, the guild began to grow bigger.

"Off you go with your useless ability!"

"Ah, then you wouldn't mind it if I take them in, yes?"

"We don't need people with low stats here!"

"You dumping this kid? Are you people off your rockers...?"

In Eisen's emerging guild, talented people who cannot be measured by numerical values gather, and eventually the name of the guild will be echoed all around the world. Conversely, the S-ranked party that couldn't see beyond the numerical value of their status and abandoned these people will tumble and fall in their pursuit of failure. Then they will learn who were the incompetent ones all along.

"Oh, so now your party is on the brink of collapse? That's what you get for ditching your precious friend!"

title.native: ようこそ『追放者ギルド』へ ～無能なSランクパーティがどんどん有能な冒険者を追放するので、最弱を集めて最強ギルドを創ります～
title.romaji: Youkoso "Tsuihousha Guild" e: Munou na S Rank Party ga Dondon Yuunou na Boukensha wo Tsuihou suru node, Saijaku wo Atsumete Saikyou Guild wo Tsukurimasu

synonyms: Onna Banchou Saraiyari Shikyuu Uzuite Tomerannee

title.native: 女番町拐いヤリ“子宮”疼いて“止”めらんねぇ

130810.description:
The start of a happy life together with a high school girl who has fallen into the bottom of despair.

One day, Yuusuke Yuuki, who spent his high school life only in studying and working part-time in order to maintain his scholarship, found himself strongly wishing for a girlfriend. On the way home, feeling lonely from such thought, he casually looked up into the sky and saw a girl who was about to throw herself off the rooftop of an abandoned building.

"Why the hell are you doing something like this!" "Because I...don't have any...reason to live..." "Wait. It'd be a shame for a beauty to die" "....?" "Rather than dying, be my girlfriend" "Eeh?"

Thus, a new love story and daily life with a mysterious girl, Kotori Hatsushiro, which all started from a strange encounter, begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: What Happens If You Saved A High School Girl Who Was About To Jump Off?
救了想一躍而下的女高中生會發生什麼事？

title.native: 飛び降りようとしている女子高生を助けたらどうなるのか？
title.romaji: Tobioriyou to Shiteiru Joshikousei wo Tasuketara Dounaru no ka?

title.native: キュラシア・ブラッド・ブラザーズ

130812.description: 2030, Kibouzu Street in Tokyo Bay City. The territory of the Herabu Nakakai, a group of deformed yakuza. In a corner of this city overflowing with desire, office worker Rei sells her body every night to satisfy her unfulfilled instincts. However, after meeting a strange boy named Arata, she is thrown into a fierce battle with the Herabu Nakakai.

title.native: ジャガイモ畑の子どもたち
中毒!? セックスカウター
ままごとレジスタンス

130819.description:
Qatora was once a valiant knight of the Razanate Empire who gave her life to protect a young imperial noble. The tragedy cast her into the primordial Light of Origin, which not only revealed to her a dangerous secret... but also reincarnated her! She now lives as Lyse Winslette, the humble daughter of a poor baron in a neighboring country, who is doing everything in her power to keep her distance from the empire because of the forbidden knowledge she possesses. Lyse thus works her days away at the royal palace of Olwen as a lady-in-waiting. And she’s rightfully mortified when she’s chosen to attend the visiting Razanate emperor. Little does she know that she’s about to learn another state secret that’s going to land her... an engagement to an imperial knight?! She’ll have to use all her skills—from this life and her last—to get out of this mess. Yet what is this strange feeling when she touches her fiancé’s hand? Just who is Sidis, and what secrets is HE keeping?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Emperor's Lady-in-Waiting Is Wanted as a Bride
title.native: 皇帝つき女官は花嫁として望まれ中
title.romaji: Koutei-tsuki Nyokan wa Hanayome to shite Nozomare-chuu

130820.description:
Although she had traveled to the Royal Capital to train as a lady of the court, before she realized it, the daughter of an impoverished Earl was seen as nothing more than another of the servants. It was during one of her usual morning cleaning rounds when by chance the Crown Prince Isaac, who was rumored for one reason or another to keep all women at arm's length, passed by, but...

When she tried to return the document he dropped, she got caught up in a maelstrom of trouble!?

And for that matter, what do you mean that happens to all the women who approach the Crown Prince...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: にわか令嬢は王太子殿下の雇われ婚約者
title.romaji: Niwaka Reijou wa Outaishi Denka no Yatoware Konyakusha

130822.description:
Eiji Akuta is a playboy who loves to seduce his co-workers. He loves sex more than any meal.
Nazuna Yoneura, who works at the same company, just loves to eat.
This is a gourmet romantic comedy between total opposites!

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

130823.description:
Kayoko Enoki leads the Tokyo branch of "The Breakfast Club," an organization that aids victims seeking revenge in a way different from Kamo and Tora. Abducted and sexually assaulted at the age of eight, what drove her to join this mysterious group?

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: 朝食会 RISE OF BREAKFAST CLUB
スモーキング・サベージ

130828.description:
In 1258 A.D., the small city of Bija on the Persian plateau was besieged by a branch of the Mongol army, which had conquered half the world with their powerful cavalry. The Mongols numbered 20,000, while the population of Bija was only 5,000. Their eventual fall was clear for all to see… The story depicts the invasion of Persia by the Mongol Empire, the battle for the small city-state of Bija, and its desperate resistance against the greatest upheaval in history. With the involvement of a mysterious group, the “Indian Inkers,” this is the most unorthodox “historical drama” in the history of gekiga manga!

(Source: Comic Border, translated)

130829.description:
Yuto and Iori are childhood friends who are always together, to the point where everyone treat them like a couple.
In fact, Yuto has always had a crush on Iori, but he is afraid to tell her for fear of ruining their friendship... One day, Iori tells Yuto that she has a new boyfriend, but Yuto gets jealous and pushes her away.
synonyms: Love Coming Apart At The Seams

130833.description:
Aoi's superior at work is a man of few words and inscrutable thoughts, but he made her heart flutter with his sudden smile and thoughtfulness. Kyo finally met someone at work whose large physique is exactly her type, and ever since, she's wondered what it would be like to touch him... or hug him...! She can't stop her mind from fantasizing about it!

A collection of sweet office romances that will inevitably tug at one's heartstrings!

(Source: Shodensha, translated)
synonyms: The Reasons We Fall in Love

130835.description:
What's in store for 32-year-old virgin and feeling insecure about her lack of experience?! Maiko Kousaka is your average office worker, except she has a secret that absolutely can't get out! Even though she's over 30, she still hasn't done "it". Desperate to change things, she decides to take matters into her own hands.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

130836.description: Motoki continued to send emails that were never delivered to his beloved. Until one day, he receives an answer that will transform his depressive life. A unique mystery about an unforgettable "girlfriend".

130837.description:
After his father’s remarriage, Yuuta suddenly becomes stepsiblings with his classmate Saki. Yuuta isn’t great at talking to women, but as the two settle into a shared lifestyle, could their relationship blossom into something more?

(Source: Yen Press)

130838.description:
A CEO with a degree from Tokyo University, a newspaper reporter, the president of an publishing company, and an IT engineer. All of them have experienced divorce. The "divorce stories told by men," serialized in a web magazine for women, sparked a huge controversy in the comments section. This is a must-read for all men and women living in modern Japan, where it is said that one in three couples will divorce. The laughable reality of marriage, as seen through divorce.

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title.native: グッドジョブ八百屋銀次郎編

130840.description:
She was a top agent of the twenty-first century with divine medical skills. She transmigrated into the prime minister's manor as their third daughter, an ugly woman known far and wide to be a useless loser. Who could have known? When she came back again, she became an one-of-a-kind summoner with astonishing abilities! She thought her life was about to get better. Much to her surprise, an unexpected scheming prince walking into her life...

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: Hoàng Thúc Cuồng Cưng Chiều Vương Phi
พระชายาอวบเอิบ คว้าใจลุงอ๋องสายตาเสีย

130842.description:
It's a story of the hopeful romance between Ju Sang-Hyeok, an official at the Ministry of Economics and Finance, and Hyeon I-Su, an aspiring writer, and the rough chemistry between them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

130843.description:
When Zak and the guardians left... The helpless people of Aria City were attacked. As the people despaired...There was a single gunshot: Zak was back.

(Source: Toomics)

130844.description:
In a futuristic, reunified Korea, a lone special forces agent is assigned to protect the idol group ORDO.

(Source: Toomics)

130845.description:
Lin Zi Yang has had feelings for his upperclassman Qing since he was 14. From that moment, health points have appeared above his head Now as an adult, his life gets turned upside down when Qing becomes his assistant. Somehow, this makes his health points decrease..?

(Source: Dong Li, translated)
synonyms: 9 Lives Man – Un amour à sens unique

130847.description:
Akira Eto is an office worker whose life revolves around games. She used to have a partner in crime, Megumi Makise, but after a certain incident in high school, she can't even look at his face again without bursting into tears. By a twist of fate, she goes to a mixer and ends up across from someone who's his spitting image! She thinks it's Megumi at first, but "Keiichi Sagami" and his calm and cool demeanor is so different to the hot-headed Megumi she remembers. The hot guy sitting so close to her makes Akira's heart beat faster, and he even likes games, too. She invites him over to play games without really thinking it through...

As a penalty for losing to him, Keiichi kisses her on the back of the hand, and things only escalate from there. Even though it's Megumi's face staring at her with desire, she can't push him away...! On top of all that, he even confesses his feelings for her!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Keiichi Sagami Is an Impostor -Sleeping with the Childhood Friend I Despise-
title.native: 相上さんはニセモノ～大嫌いな幼なじみに抱かれます～
title.romaji: Sagami-san ha Nisemono: Dai Kirai na Osananajimi ni Dakaremasu

130848.description:
Does the savior really exist? If it does exist, it won’t be deity or extraterrestrial... It must be a creature of human beings. 13 years ago, a transit space station, between the earth and the moon, accidentally fell during its way back. The Robo Master, Padma Knight appeared in front of all human beings around the world and saved the space station, amazingly that shocked the world. The new era of robo came.

(Source: MangaToon)

130850.description: High-School girl Akari is 17 years old and doesn't know what she wants to do in the future. One day, on her way to school, she gets hits by car and wakes up possessed by the spirit of an actress who wants a little more time to bring her life to closure before she passes on.

130854.description:
Kazuma's just your regular office worker... Except for the fact that he likes playing with his ass so much, he's been holding off on masturbating for two weeks. One weekend, on the way home from one of his usual self-loving sessions in a soundproofed, easily-cleaned hotel room... he happens upon his junior colleague Maruyama and gets roped into drinking with him! Later, when carrying a passed-out drunk Maruyama to bed, Kazuma catches sight of Maruyama's raging boner...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Junior's so Tolerant It's Scary.
title.native: 俺の後輩の懐が深すぎてこわい。
title.romaji: Ore no Kouhai no Futokoro ga Fukasugite Kowai.

130855.description:
A story about two Kyoto boys and their everyday lives filled with fun times, sexy times, and heartwarming moments. Osugi and Take are college classmates and best friends. Osugi, who's handsome but a total letdown on the inside, tells Take how he feels about him... Which is nice and all, but Take just gets shocked at everything he does... "Are you some kinda perv!?" Best friends? Or lovers? What does fate have in store for these two!?

(Source: Renta!)

130856.description:
After his dream of becoming a professional musician was crushed, Ren was forced to work at the kindergarten run by his parents. Ren's unmotivated and lazy personality clashes with that of the super serious teacher Kiichi, whom he watches closely every day. However, Kiichi's straightforward kindness and purity creates new and unique feelings...

Note: Chapter count includes two extras from the volume release.
synonyms: Even Teachers Want  to do a Naughty Thing

title.native: センセーだってやらしいことしたい

130857.description:
17-year-old Daeun has always been a hopeless romantic. When she moves into a new apartment in Seoul, she falls head over heels for her handsome neighbor. Turns out, they're classmates, so it has to be destiny, right? But could he really be her Prince Charming? Or is he hiding a dark past?

(Source: Manta)

130858.description:
Hachisu, a boy with a good grasp of the world around him, gets sat next to a girl in his class called Ageha, who is utterly lost in her own existence. Hachisu feels irritated every time he sees her and thinks that that will never change.

The sad love story of two people who come to understand the complexity of human emotions by interacting with each other.

(Source: Comico, translated)

130859.description:
Oneshot promoting the first volume of the Light Novel "Alya, Who Sits Next to Me, Sometimes Whispers Sweet Nothings in Russian". Popularity may result in a serialization!

Follow the story of the ice-cold perfect beauty, the half-Russian Alisa "Alya" Mikhailovna Kujo, and your average high school underachiever, Masachika Kuze. She has a cold exterior, but speaks her love in a language she thinks nobody understands... Little does she know that he understands her just fine! Enjoy the silly slice-of-life romance between Snow Princess and Mr. Worldwide!
synonyms: Alya, Who Sits Next to Me, Sometimes Whispers Sweet Nothings in Russian

I've become a big, hairy beast!
After getting into a car accident, Hanbyul wakes up in the body of a princess. But something's wrong; she's doubled in size, grown hair everywhere, and seems to terrify everyone who looks her way — she's become a beast! How will she live on as the cursed Princess Alexa?

130864.description:
Takumi is a neat freak who shies away from touching others, while Sakura is a goofball who tends to overstep personal boundaries. Even though it pains him to do so, smart and successful Takumi finds himself tutoring Sakura on a regular basis. Over the course of their study sessions, they finally start to break the ice. But then, Takumi discovers that Sakura is actually a...

The love story of a guy with no sense of personal space and a stoic student council member trying to overcome germaphobia.

(Source: Renta!)

"I'm scared... Scared of how easily I get turned on...!" The cool, expressionless honors student is actually someone who melts in your hands as she squirts everywhere!?

130867.description:
Kohei Sugihara, college student with hearing loss, and Taichi Sagawa, his ever-optimistic former classmate, met in a chance encounter that ignited an undeniable spark that would eventually blossom into love.

Now it’s spring and as Kohei nears graduation, his search for a job begins. Meanwhile, Taichi finds himself in charge of someone new at work. Life is busier than ever, but all in all, things seem to be looking up for the pair. That is, until the sudden appearance of Ena, one of Kohei’s old flames.

(Source: One Peace Books)

130868.description:
Taichi was reincarnated as Isaac, an apprentice gardener in the world of an otome game. But, looking back, Isaac wasn't even part of the game... This is the story of the interweaving lives of the Duke's daughter, Lydia, and a boy who isn't even an NPC.

(Source: MANGA UP!)

Otome Game no Mob desura naindaga

130869.description:
After touring America in an attempt to start a new life, Hui-Su boards a plane back to her homeland of Korea. She soon realizes that it is not so easy to escape her unfortunate destiny when the plane spirals out of control and she is warped to a strange world that is distant from Earth and full of zombie-like creatures called “maenok.” Luckily enough, she is unintentionally rescued from a dire situation by an elegant and refined gentleman named Calix Clovis, who possesses the mysterious ability to wield a blue flame that can kill the maenok. He is a chaste paladin who has sworn his body to the Church, but Hui-Su quickly notices his physical reaction to her naturally seductive charms. Will she succeed in surviving by using her feminine wiles to win over Calix’s heart and body?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
synonyms: หัวใจที่ปลายหนาม

130870.description:
When Seo Jun-Ho and his companions sacrificed themselves to defeat the frost queen, they thought they were restoring peace to Earth. But after 25 years of being frozen solid, Jun-Hho thaws out only to find that nine more floors appeared in his absence, only one of which has been cleared! As the only one who holds the key to clearing the next floor and defrosting his friends, Jun-Ho must step up once again. But has this hero been in hibernation too long to take on the world’s fearsome new foes?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Our ages and lives are so different. But I… still want to be with you. Why do you love someone, when their ages, personalities, thoughts, and appearances have nothing in common. The story of two women who discover how they fulfill each other.

130874.description: Finding himself lost and confused in a ruined world on the brink of collapse, Keisuke meets a young half-elf girl by the name of Nito. Nito seems to be searching for the "Golden Sea" as described in her mother's journal and Keisuke agrees to accompany her on her journey. The two set forth, meeting and parting with all kinds of people...

Momota, a retired Ping Pong coach is brought in to coach teach the "Double Jump" technique to the Big Breasted Scholarship students to perform this skill to newly established Volleyball club at a private academy. How will this new coach handle this new and unique club?

130879.description:
"I want to know who my father is!" In this sequel to hit romance series 'I Got a Boy,' more than a decade has passed since Hyojoo's restless young days and she's now the single mom of a spunky teenage daughter, Godam. But when Godam asks piercing questions about her father, the answers don't come easily. What happened to Hyojoo in all that time, and can Godam uncover the truth about their past?

(Source: TappyToon)

130881.description:
Izumi Inaba, a high school student with professional cooking skills, has been rigorously instructed by their father, a genius chef.

One day, after a huge fight with their father, Izumi travels back in time to the Bakumatsu period of Kyoto!? There they meet the famous warrior Hijikata Toshizou, who invited him to join the Shinsengumi because of their incredible cooking skills. The youth drama woven by timeless encounters opens its curtain!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Joushi to Kaisha de Game no Jikkyou wo

130883.description:
Jun Shizuki and Yukiji Yano are both in the same woodwind choir. Shizuki is a bartender who plays the sax and hits on anything that moves. Yano is a gifted flute player who is incredibly nice and is well-regarded within the choir.

No one would ever suspect that these guys would have anything in common, but could these two polar opposites actually be in a relationship?!

(Source: Animate International)

130885.description:
In a quest to subdue a golden dragon, a white mage named Amalia is double-crossed by her party, leaving her for dead with her injuries. However, the dragon takes pity on her helpless situation and restores Amalia's health in exchange for a favor: observing human life. The dragon then takes the form of a child, using "Yuugo" as an alias.

As Amalia accepts Yuugo's request, she soon realizes that ten years have since passed. Mixed with shock and confusion, Amalia tries to start a new life with Yuugo as a foster son, doing her best to fulfill her new objective. Soon enough, Yuugo begins to show interest in the culture of tea, and as someone adept in brewing them, Amalia's tea-laden life will now begin!

title.native: 捨てられ白魔法使いの紅茶生活

130889.description:
Nana Shiizaki is an honor student by day, but no one knows that she is phantom thief Amaryllis by night. Amaryllis is a thief that steals anything by request. Nana was then scouted to make an idol debut as Flower Dream Nana, and while she spends her days happily, a mysterious organization called Black Auction begins to slowly come up around her...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

130890.description: After his cat goes missing, Taichi gets a visit from a mysterious new transfer student.

130893.description:
Office worker Nimura has had a one-sided love for his colleague Shizuka since joining the company. While keeping his position as Shizuka's best friend and colleague, Nimura one day finds out that Shizuka is going to a mixer..

(Source: Leed, translated)

130894.description: Hajime Nakano is forced by his mother to enroll at a newly opened all boys high school, and he laments over having to spend the next three years surrounded by other guys. However, he doesn't know that all of the other students are girls secretly pretending to be guys, and each of them think they are the only girl in the whole school.
synonyms: Puberty, an All Boys School!? and Nakano-kun

"Oh, no... Do they know it's inside me...!?" My bike seat is soaked, and the men are gathering around to see my orgasm face...

130897.description:
It is my cursed destiny to be reborn endlessly. A king, an archmage, a slave, a saint, a witch... I’ve done it all in my thousand years of life, and frankly, I need a break! My goal now is simple: to live like an absolute sloth. Unfortunately, I am Rubia, the daughter of a grand duke with a demanding family and a fiancé to boot. To live my dream sloth life, I’m running away from it all... except no matter where I go, nobody will leave me be! I just want to nap, but being lazy is hard work!

(Source: Tapas)

I mistook my student for a call girl and attacked her! And the next day I start my new teaching job covered in her secretions!?

The lewd sounds of our bodies fade into the booms of the fireworks. Even though there are other people nearby...Unable to hold back, we drown in the forbidden pleasures.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Hanabi no Oto ni Awasete Tsukeba Barenai kara

130900.description:
To battle the alarming suicide rate, the government initiates a suicide prevention program using AI robots. CHA-88K, a humanoid robot, is placed on Mapo Bridge, the nation's highest suicide spot. "Cha Cha" receives a lot of attention in the beginning, but is eventually considered a failure and funding for the programs stops. However, Cha Cha continues to watch over the bridge. Due to her ability to infinitely synchronize with other AI robots, she can observe the private lives of many humans. Cha Cha despairs over what she sees in human society and develops something similar to depression and lethargy. Ai, CEO of White Island Nursing Home, purchases the decrepit Cha Cha from the government, brings her to the nursing home, shakes her out of her stupor, and ultimately convinces her to become Earth's next "Mother." in a futuristic society where people have become cold and calculating machines and AI robots take over many services once performed by human beings, Cha Cha, Ai, and the other AI robots force us to examine what it means to be human.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

130901.description:
Betting on TaeHwa Group's future, an A.I. created for diagnosis named Baruda! First-year neurosurgeon President Lee Soohyuk was working with Baruda when he was hit by a mysterious explosion and lost consciousness. After regaining consciousness, he met the A.I. Baruda inside his mind. Already inseparable, they are faced with a situation where they must help each other.

Baruda, who, through deep learning, aims to become the best diagnoser, and Soohyuk, who still aims to come into his own, work together to become the world's best neurosurgeon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

130902.description:
Living with 4 hot guys? She hates it. I-Rei and her mother become the center of attention when her mom wins a contest where a k-pop idol group comes to stay with them. Now I-Rei must deal with living with 4 extra family members and a love-struck mother.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

130903.description: Jae-Kyung was the one hyung Se-Ju looked up to when they were kids, but after the financial ruin of Jae-Kyung's family, the two were separated. They never saw each other once during their time apart until one day they ran into each other at the bar Jae-Kyung works at. In a moment of drunken weakness, Jae-Kyung sleeps with Se-Ju and Se-Ju proposes they keep sleeping together? Confused and adrift in life, Jae-Kyung wonders if he can continue their physical relationship.

130904.description:
Some wounds are slow to heal. Giran’s been alone ever since his grandmother died, and he has no intention of letting anyone into his life. But one day, out of nowhere, he meets an exceptionally pretty face…who’s also exceptionally good in bed. This one-night fling turns into something more when Giran finds out that his meeting with Seon-gyeong was more than just a coincidence. The two have similar pasts that are stained with painful losses. Trauma can be all-consuming, but every walk through life is made better with someone by your side.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: The chapter count follows that of Ridibooks and includes a prologue.
synonyms: The Last Step on the Way

130905.description: I already confessed to him, but he still treats me like a child...

130906.description:
"I'll let you keep me to yourself..." That playfully sweet invitation of his... I kissed him back, but we're not even dating...

(Source: Coolmic)

130907.description:
Taisei, a college student who runs a gourmet club, found a side dish shop, Nanohana. The shopkeeper Hanaoka, is beautiful and gentle, and the side dishes are delicious! Every day Taisei goes to Nanohana, and he fell in love with Hanaoka's rice at first sight. He wants to eat more of Hanaoka's rice, and wants to get closer to him.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

title.native: 今夜も君にごちそうさま

130908.description:
Masashi Noro's mother committed suicide when he was in the second year of junior high school. Noro has become apathetic to living after that incident. One day, when summer vacation is approaching, Akira Otonari, a close friend from elementary school, receives a phone call from Noro. When Akira rushed to Noro's room, a girl with a full-body burn lies there.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

130909.description:
"It'll be great if hyung can see me as an adult", worried Se-Hyun. There was no progress in the relationship with his seven-years-older lover, 'Gyeong-U'.

Following his sister's advice, though, he made a plan to appeal maturely to Gyeong-U, it had not worked out well… At last, can they spend a lovely first day together?

(Source: Bomtoon)

130910.description:
One night while walking home, Ikuko Muraoka sees a shooting star fall in the direction of her friend Sawa's home.

Note: Contains one extra chapter.

130913.description:
High-school student Dong-Jin Kim seems like a typical moody teenager, but underneath it all, he’s a powerful psychic “villain” who aims to destroy humanity. But there’s a catch -- every time he uses his powers to kill, he is thrown back in time. Trapped in this time loop, Dong-Jin tries to narrow down the culprit by doing the one thing he knows: killing those around him. Will he be able to escape from the time loop and achieve his goal as a villain?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

130914.description:
Unleashing his pent-up lust on these poor girls...

(Source: Fakku!)

Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2020-12

130916.description:
A romantic comedy between two opposing forces, the ultra-short Yu Bo-Ram and an Iljin Basketball Club member, Choi Gyeom.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

130917.description:
As the toughest fighter in the world of crime, Gijun claims victory in a battle that ends the long power struggle between Seoul's gangs. But when his brother Giseok rises in rank within the enemy group, Gijun decides to slash his own heel and leave the business to avoid fighting him. Just when all seems at peace 15 years later, Giseok is mysteriously ambushed and killed in cold blood right before his own retirement. Filled with a chilly rage, Gijun sets off on a one-man hunt to track down everyone involved in his brother's death. And he has a feeling he doesn't need to look far to find the main culprit... With revenge and old gang rivalries factoring into the equation, Seoul's underbelly is in for yet another grisly bloodbath!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: จัตุรัสเดือด

130918.description:
While working as a small supporting actor in a movie, Ki Man-Seong has nothing else going for him. However, that was when, through mysterious circumstances, the movie set had become reality during filming. With the sound of the director’s cut, during that short take, he’s not an actor but actually thrown into the events occurring, showing the pain and emotions he faces at that moment. He can only come back if he creates that perfect take…! Can he grow to become the greatest actor?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

130919.description:
Judge Lee, who believed justice could be realized in the courtroom, did not follow the orders of his superiors and sentenced the conglomerate to life in prison before being killed. But is it because of the shenanigans he heard as a child? With all his memories, Lee gets a second life chance. The world needs him, Lee, the heretic of the judiciary, who knows only justice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

130920.description:
Sakuya Akatsuki is not your average hypersensitive uke. After try touching himself once and feeling no arousal, he considered being frigid. His roommate Mitsuki Toujou promptly offers to help him achieve his goal: anal orgasm. What switch should be pushed so that it happens?

Note: The chapter count includes an extra chapter.

title.native: えっちは週7希望ですっ！

130923.description:
A man who has lost his beloved family. A desperate time travel to save his family begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

130924.description:
Taking orders from his boss, Namsoo goes to Baek-ho’s Gang in order to take care of some business. But little did he know that Baek-ho’s Gang’s namesake and leader would take a particular liking to Namsoo and capture him all for his own. Now Namsoo just desperately wants to escape but how will he break free from this insatiable lust…?

(Soure: Lezhin)

130925.description: A suspicious man named Odagiri, who's known as a "Fairy Doctor," is looking for a specific fairy. One day, he happens upon the home of a grandma who owns a very lovely garden. The fairies he met there were–

title.romaji: Yousei Hakase to Hana no Tsuru

130926.description:
Full of Love Daycare ensures each child is ready for the 21st century, and its hunky teachers are the heart-stopping crushes of all the town moms. Plunked in between her muscle-clad and pretty boy colleagues, can the newly-hired female teacher Seun-Gah survive the glares of jealous mothers, let alone the hectic kids in her class? More importantly, can she resist all the eye-candy around her?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

130927.description:
A world where 11 Kings with absolute reign live protected by knights. Apprentice knight Hinta, together with his partner Kanut, venture on a journey to become appointed as formal knights. An action-packed fantasy story of two boys as they fight to become real knights!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 俺攻め×君受け ~理想の推し属性~
title.romaji: Ore Seme x Kimi Uke: Risou no Oshi Zokusei

130933.description:
“Make me think it's okay if you're the one who eats me...”

In the mountains somewhere, a tiger catches its prey—a lone dragon, the kind that is hardly ever seen. Eating the dragon’s meat extracts the ultimate flavor, drinking its blood heals all one’s injuries, devouring its heart grants immortality...and yet, upon seeing the dragon’s undeveloped stature, the tiger refuses to eat it. Dragon and tiger, predator and prey—is what ties them together simply natural hunting instincts, or something more...?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Tiger Hasn’t Eaten the Dragon Yet

title.english: The Tiger Won't Eat the Dragon Yet
title.native: 虎は龍をまだ喰べない。
title.romaji: Tora wa Ryuu wo Mada Tabenai.

130934.description:
By the time he realized what was going on, Yamagishi Amizuna, a salaryman, was in a strange cave, and in front of his eyes was a giant black tiger...!?

When he thought his life ended after being attacked by the tiger, he awoke once again in the same place. Amizuna desperately struggled in an irrational situation without understanding the goal. It's a game where you have to use your own body to level up and beat dungeons. He died countless times and was resurrected in the same place, drawing lessons one by one, while gaining more clues and the abilities to pass the stages.

All to get out of this crazy game...

Return to Death x Level up. The actions that a salaryman must take in order to get stronger and survive!

title.native: サラリーマンの不死戯なダンジョン

130935.description:
Zion, a solo adventurer, recklessly entered a dungeon beyond his ability. Alas, that was the last thing he did. Wandering inside a dungeon for hundreds of years, as an undead, he kept advancing into the dungeon. Slaying monster left and right until his undead body underwent "evolution" many times over. By the time he regained his ego, he had already become the strongest undead: "No Life King."

The humankind, who was made aware of the appearance of a new world-class disaster monster, felt dread as they fell into the abyss of despair. "The world is... done for." Or so they thought. This was the tale of the humans who trembled in fear and him, an undead, who actually had no intention to destroy the world.
synonyms: After Spending Hundreds of Years as a Common Undead, I’ve Become The Strongest Undead When I Woke up

title.native: ただの屍のようだと言われて幾星霜、気づいたら最強のアンデッドになってた
title.romaji: Tada no Shikabane no You da to Iwarete Ikuseisou, Kizuitara Saikyou no Undead ni Natteta

130936.description:
Zion has always dreamed of becoming a great adventurer, so he leaves his small hometown in the boonies to head for the city. He is able to quickly move up in the ranks, until he suffers a fatal wound in a dungeon far beyond his abilities and his dreams are cut short. As he lays dying, his blood is mixed with the essence of a just-fallen dragon. For hundreds of years, his soul is steeped in this mixture... and then he reawakens as the strongest undead!

With shocking white hair and blood red eyes, Zion is the very epitome of an undead, a race feared by humans for their lack of self and vile nature. However, unlike most of his kind, he retains his memories and (admittedly shy) personality from the past. Wielding unimaginable power but none of the will to use it, Zion journeys across an unfamiliar world, searching for a way to finally end his own life. From corrupt necromancers to all-powerful dragons, why can't any of them lay a scratch on him?!

(Source: MAL Rewrite)
synonyms: After Spending Hundreds of Years as a Common Undead, I’ve Become The Strongest Undead When I Woke up

title.native: ただの屍のようだと言われて幾星霜、気づいたら最強のアンデッドになってた
title.romaji: Tada no Shikabane no You da to Iwarete Ikuseisou, Kizuitara Saikyou no Undead ni Natteta

130938.description:
After losing his girlfriend to a brave hero, Toru is expelled from his S-Rank party. With a feeling of sadness and pain in his heart, he defeats a demon he meets outside the city, and his ability [to save experience] is broken! Toru becomes level 300 in the blink of an eye! With this power that far surpasses that of heroes, there is nothing that can stop him. Kaede, a slave he met on his journey, forms a group called the “Mangyu Brigade”, and easily completes dungeons, acquires the legendary sacred weapons, and thanks to his skills, his friends level up easily! He rescued a countess who was attacked by bandits on the road and befriended a legendary beast. Oru’s journey continues at a leisurely pace, as he repeatedly encounters various people along the way, while his former party of heroes is deprived of opportunities to play an active role and fall into decline.
This is the beginning of the life of a 300 level warrior!
synonyms: A Warrior Exiled by the Hero and His Lover

title.native: 経験値貯蓄でのんびり傷心旅行 ～勇者と恋人に追放された戦士の無自覚ざまぁ～
title.romaji: Keikenchi Chochiku de Nonbiri Shoushin Ryokou: Yuusha to Koibito ni Tsuihou Sareta Senshi no Mujikaku zamaa

130940.description:
A haughty man from the year 3362 x Third-rate joker streamer in 2019. Lin Shu, living solo since birth, has encountered a huge crisis in life. A pervert who claimed to be from the future snuck into his house, and wants to absorb his energy? His dream of starting a family and living a normal life is about to be crushed. How will he go on?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, an epilogue, and 2 extra chapters.

130942.description:
Getting hit by a truck and sent to another world to face off against the Demon King was the best thing that ever happened to Yuuta. He attained unmatched powers, saved the world, and even married the princess. But now that the adventure’s over, he finds himself in a boring, sexless marriage with no battles left to fight. The only excitement he can find comes from sneaking out for intimate nights with his former party member. Can the powers he once used to save the realm keep him from getting busted by his royal family?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: ISEKAI AFFAIR: 10 Years After Defeating the Demon King, the Hero Cheats on His Wife With a Warrior Woman Who Lost Her Husband
title.native: 異世界不倫～魔王討伐から十年、妻とはレスの元勇者と、夫を亡くした女戦士～
title.romaji: Isekai Furin: Maou Toubatsu kara Juunen, Tsuma to wa Resu no Moto Yuusha to, Otto wo Nakushita Onna Senshi

130943.description:
Even though he is not interested in anime, Jiro Shinonome starts a new job as a Production Assistant at the anime studio "Is This It?". With no knowledge of the subject he falls behind his coworkers from the first day on. Will he find his "goal" and get into the demanding job? On top of that he has to deal with his neighbor who mistakes him for a molester after an unfortunate incident.
"This is it!" mixes the harsh reality of working in the anime industry with a romantic comedy.

title.native: THIS IS IT! 制作進行東雲次郎
title.romaji: THIS IS IT! Seisaku Shinkou Shinonome Jirou

130945.description:
I can't believe the face I made when my subordinate told me he loved me. No one's ever gotten erect over me, so I don't know what to do...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Why Would You Get Hard Over Me, Your Boss?
title.native: 社長の私に勃ちっこないでしょ?
title.romaji: Shachou no Watashi ni Tachikko Naidesho?

130946.description:
"That scheming boss is my ex-boyfriend?!"

What will happen when she meets her first love again...

It's a story about urban romance happening in the office. Intoxicated, Xiao Aiai "shared a bed" with the President of Student Union in her high school, and he’s also the General Manager of a company who constantly helped her in the dark. A romance story full of twists between a scheming, domineering president and a simple stubborn office lady.

(Source: Webcomics)

130947.description:
In this world, demons threaten to emerge from corrupted hearts. To protect everyone, each person’s chest is installed with a Heartlock with varying degrees of security. But young Louis can afford only the simplest of Heartlock since he has no money or privilege. After his innermost desires are exposed by his closest friend, he is framed and sent away. Surrounded by the demons of other tormented inmates, can the innocent Louis and his delicate heart survive this new hell?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: กุญแจขังใจ

130948.description:
He expressed his feelings, and they even slept together. But, are their hearts one?

Ryota's a college student with a pierced ear that won't quite heal. He's been in love with his high school teacher Mr. Hiragi since day one. He even got Mr. Hiragi to pierce him...

The day he heard Ryota's feelings for him, Mr. Hiragi accepted his student without hesitation. Mr. Hiragi doesn't even turn Ryota away when he visits. But, no phone calls or texts. Unsure of his teacher's feelings, Ryota stops going to see him. Until, that is, he hears a rumor that Mr. Hiragi's got himself a girlfriend...

Other stories include the sequel to the above, "When Piercing an Ear"; and love stories between two high schoolers, "A Lull in Spring" and "I See You When I Close My Eyes."

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ピアスホールは塞げない

130949.description:
Coffee is a cash crop, too bad Declan doesn’t have any money. Terribly in debt, he plans to sell his family’s countryside coffee plantation. His father agrees…if he can master the trifecta of coffee: bean variety, brewing technique, and latte art. He has a month to make the perfect blend and Liam, the cool, attractive, barista will teach him.

How do you like your coffee? At The Cat’s Meowcchiato, it’s always hot.

(Source: Tapas)

130950.description:
"You're a good boy, so don't lick me there...!" His body shakes with sensitivity as his scar is caressed... He can't believe his cute childhood friend is doing such a thing...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: とろけるスカーフェイス

130951.description:
A wild food that carries the virus, leading to the advent of the apocalypse, the global human into the zombie crisis, a terminally ill teenager was attacked by zombies, not only incurable disease is cured, there is also the consciousness of normal people! Is this a misfortune? Or lucky?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: After the End of the World I Became a Zombie

130952.description:
Will lovers who have been in love for many years really be defeated by time? When fate brings the third people to them, is there any chance for them to make a promise to each other?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ta Yu Ta de Elie Wanxiao

130953.description:
Egregor is a story of four young heroes in a fantastic medieval universe in which a ruthless threat looms. Each of their destinies will be intertwined through their encounters and discoveries that they will make their lives. They will be guided to explore a mysterious world, filled with darkness.

A young blacksmith apprentice will have to discover these mysteries at the expense of everything he appreciates. Doomed to become a great hero, he must be careful not to be seduced by Evil and not end up embodying everything he hated...

Note: Reboot from the original Egregor manfra by Kaya Tachibana & Harumo Sanazaki (which was cancelled) based on Jay Skwar's original idea. The idea was later on picked up again and restarted as a manhwa by Jae-Hwan Kim in collaboration with Jay Skwar. This new version was first published on the Korean platforms Ridibooks and Naver Webtoons.

130955.description:
Family murder 15 years ago ──. Shuhei Sakata, the criminal who killed his wife and child and attempted suicide, was released for the first time in 15 years. However, it was a trap by "demons" ...! Sakata miraculously awakens from the vegetative state and vows to revenge only in the town of the cause of the legend of demon possession!!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title.native: 調理刑事の捜索ごはん

130957.description:
Makoto, Miho, Yuusuke, Toshio, Kana and Rintaro are 6 friends from high school. All of them have a dark past: they used to participate in tormenting a classmate... Makoto, who is soon going to marry Miho, receives an anonymous message that contains proof of her having sugar daddies. "Miho... has sugar daddies...?". Makoto discovers a side of his fiancée he never knew about, and so does Miho who receives a message exposing her fiancé's dating application profile, bringing them to doubt each other. "Someone's trying to tear us apart... Could it be... him?". Someone is skillfully using the internet to drag them into hell. Could it be the revenge of a tormented classmate?! Discover a chilling psychological horror comic that will captivate you with its disturbing development!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: To the Demons From My Past

130959.description:
A part-time job at a date club is an easy win!

Atsuki, a chara man who loves to play with girls, visited a dating club part-time job interview. However, the dubious store manager ordered a male customer to try it out. I went out on a date with a gentleman who was acquainted with the store manager, but I was at the mercy of the behavior of a gentleman who was somehow ukiyo-e. Apparently, the guys at this dating club aren't straightforward !?

(Source: Pixiv Comic)

title.native: 甘い魔ものデートクラブ

130960.description: What types of sounds does the encounter of an emotionally wounded young man and a very shy girl sound?

synonyms: Silver wolf cries in full moon

title.romaji: Oborozukiyo ni Gin Ookami to Naku

title.native: お母さんを愛していなかったお父さんの話
title.romaji: Okaasan wo Aishite Inakatta Otousan no Hanashi

130964.description: As a child of God, Misia's "work" is to kill the sinners of the world. One day, she meets a boy Yuma during her "work" and decides to bring him along. And the gears begin to turn on a twisted adventure between two cruel but innocent souls. A powerful 81-page one-shot by a 17-year old author.

130965.description:
When the son of a cult leader is transported to a world without religion he must bring the god he despised with him to save the world! The first volume in an ongoing series (with a hit anime adaptation now on Crunchyroll) Working for God in a Godless World is an all-new take on the isekai genre! When Urabe is sacrificed by his father to the all-powerful Mitama, he prays that he can finally be without religion. He wakes up in a placid world free of faith, and begins a new life there, but when the truth is revealed, that the ruling empire purges the citizens, Urabe must find his faith and summon Mitama to protect them!

(Source: Titan Manga)
synonyms: โลกนี้ โลกหน้า ข้าก็เป็นพระเจ้า
God’s Activity in a World Without Gods
God's Activity in a Godless World
Meine Arbeit als Missionar in einer gottlosen Welt

title.english: Working for God in a Godless World
title.native: 神無き世界のカミサマ活動

130966.description:
Another world is quite hard to understand!　A fantasy of a hardworking girl's DIY struggle!

One day, Kurisu, a girl who was born and raised in a remote area, learns that she has the [House Building Skill]. When her memories of being Kurisu Niina, a Japanese woman, come back to her, she decides to leave the remote area and become an adventurer. After a grueling journey, she arrives in the labyrinthine city of Garel, and tries to build her own house and enjoy living alone, but the officials tell her that people from other countries can't even live there permanently. Thinking, "If so, let's make a house where you can travel!", she remodels a used carriage and begins to make an ideal home.
Now begins the story of a girl who lives single-mindedly in a different world where her life depends on her skills!

title.native: 家つくりスキルで異世界を生き延びろ
title.romaji: Ie Tsukuri Skill de Isekai wo Ikinobiro

130967.description: Gou and Shinji are roommates in a high school dormitory. Shinji was always calm against the ferocious Gou, and the people around him wondered why these two were best friends, but in reality, Shinji has a feeling that no one can tell.

130968.description:
Due to his dad’s flighty tendencies, Kyoichi has been constantly moving from one place to the next his entire life, never even getting the chance to make a friend. The latest move takes him to a peaceful rural town, where he intends to live quietly and not stand out until he graduates. But that plan is quickly interrupted by his oddball classmate Leo, who pulls Kyoichi into his chaotic antics and his circle of friends!

(Source: MANGA UP!)

130969.description:
Shouta, a man in his late 20s, works at a nursery school and tries his best to make the children laugh and smile. However, the children seem to have a hard time paying attention to his comedic storytelling.

One night, he goes to a storytelling theater and ends up getting some useful advice from a woman who performed in the show. Afterward, he re-tells his comedic story in a way that is extremely well accepted by the laughing children and he decides that performing storytelling is what he wants to do with his life. Soon, he begins to take steps to make this dream a reality.

130970.description:
Touichi Mashimo is a famous actor renowned for playing princes and gentlemen. After learning that his favorite playwright will be directing a play, Touichi challenges himself to branch out from his usual roles. At the audition, Touichi meets a young and lively Kakeru Matsumoto. Being paired up to audition together, Touichi is enraptured by Kakeru's acting. The pair end up booking the roles of lovers and are assigned to live together as their roles to immerse the play with their reality. Will they be able to separate their emotions from their professional ones?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ロマンス ウィズ エチュード

130971.description:
One day, the marquess's daughter, Julianne, regains her memories of her previous life and reflects on her behavior in this life. Extravagant, bullying her siblings, stalking her fiancée - She realized her devotion to wickedness, combined with her vile personality and fattened appearance, perfectly mirrored the villainess of a novel she had once read about in her previous life. If I’m going to be taken down in the future, then I might as well clean up my body and soul! With this thought in mind, her new diet and devotion to her family had begun!

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: The Struggle of Being Reincarnated as the Marquess's Daughter: I'll Deal with What’s Coming to Me!

title.english: The Struggles of a Reincarnated Marquess's Daughter--- I'll be taken down in Style!
title.native: 転生侯爵令嬢奮闘記　わたし、立派にざまぁされてみせます！
title.romaji: Tensei Koushaku Reijou Funtouki: Watashi, Rippa ni Zamaasaretemisemasu!

130972.description: A romantic comedy about a high school detective.

title.native: 名探偵なんかじゃない！～高校生探偵バトルロイヤル～
title.romaji: Meitantei Nanka Janai!: Koukousei Tantei Battle Royale

130973.description:
Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: คนพันธุ์เหล็ก เห็ดพันธุ์โหด

title.native: J.boy セカンドシーズン
バーサスアース78アフター ウォーハンマー

130977.description: On his way to school, university student Minoru sees a beautiful young man standing by the window of a small Western-style building and falls in love with him at first sight. Half a year later, he is approached by Toshitsugu, the man of his dreams, and is invited into his home, where he spends the night. However, the following morning when Toshitsugu learns that Minoru is underage, he tells him he must wait until his twentieth birthday the following month.
synonyms: Jozu ni Mate ga Dekiru Kana

title.native: 上手に待てができるかな
title.romaji: Jouzu ni Mate ga Dekiru Kana

title.native: フラレた後のファンタジー

130980.description:
Wakashio, who lives in a seaside village, was in secret love with Yakaze from the forest tribe. For Wakashio, who lives a constrictive life as the youngest child of the chief, the only comfort he could experience was the time spent with Yakaze. However, Yakaze is killed by Wakashio's older brother who knew about their relationship. After this tragedy Wakashio reunites with Yakaze. However, he returned deformed with bright red eyes on pale skin. It looks like a monster, but his heart is still human. The two who loved each other as they once began to find a way to live together.

(Source: Kasakura Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

130981.description: A story about the daily lives of two roommates, Fuantei-san, a slightly unstable illustrator, and Shikkari-san, a capable career woman.

title.native: 同居人が不安定でして

130982.description:
A world where humans and fantasy beings coexist... A human police officer, Ogihara Hagi, patrols the city with his dragon partner, Hinagiku. Together, the odd duo—a careless, good-for-nothing human and a kind-hearted, earnest dragon—solves crimes. The odd couple of a careless good-for-nothing human and a scary looking but earnest and gentle dragon are on the case!

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

title.native: ドラゴンのおまわりさん

130983.description:
Whip works at a drag bar in Tokyo, where they interact with some of the most interesting people in society. But at home their days are often spent by idly chatting via a phone app with a user named "Insomniac Salaryman." Their conversations are nothing much more than grumbling about their day-to-days. So when Whip develops some light romantic feelings for this person that they have never met, they dismiss it as a romance that will never happen.

(Source: Kuma)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Even if There's No Rainbow Tomorrow
Dù ngày mai không có cầu vồng

title.english: Even if There's No Rainbow Tomorrow
title.native: あした虹がでなくても

130986.description: Asuna, who runs a detective agency, meets Seiji, a coffee shop worker near his new office. Seiji has a rebellious attitude, but also a charming aura... Asuna is intrigued by him and frequently visits the coffee shop. Seiji, who runs the store by himself, gradually begins to open up his heart to Asuna, who has become a regular customer. One night, noticing this, Asuna touches Seiji in an obscene manner as a thank you...

130987.description:
Yuuki Yugi is a college student with looks that make girls swoon and hand him their contact information. People envy Yuuki for being attractive and assume he is a playboy, with girls falling for him left and right. But the truth is, Yuuki does not want to be with girls the way they want to be with him. But is he gay? The only way he can confirm or deny that for himself is to try being with a man. With mixed feelings, insecurities, and doubts from a difficult childhood, Yuuki approaches Yu Koba, a regular at the restaurant Yuuki works for, to answer his questions. Little does he know that Koba has his past to face, much like Yuuki himself.

(Source: Futekiya)

9. Suteki na Present (素敵なプレゼント)

130989.description: Publisher Hayakawa is celebrating its 70th anniversary with two manga anthology reprints. One collection is dedicated to mystery works while the other compiles sci-fi stories printed over the publisher's long career.
synonyms: Comic M: Hayakawa Publishing 70th Anniversary Comic Anthology [Mystery] Edition

title.romaji: Comic M: Hayakawa Shobou Souritsu 70 Shuunenkinen Comic Anthology [Mystery-hen]

130990.description:
1. Sennyuu! Boyish (潜入！ボーイッシュ); Comic LO 2016-12
2. Pool de Challenge! Boyish (プールでチャレンジ！ボーイッシュ); Comic LO 2017-12
3. Hatsushigoto (はつしごと); Comic LO 2017-10

5. Sakibashiri Training (先走りトライアングル); Comic LO 2017-04
6. Orikou! Wild Girl (おりこう！ワイルドガール); Comic LO 2017-06
